_comment: Trait definitions, SPEC.md §5. A trait is one hook and one modifier: { stat, op, value }, where op is add or set and stat is one the hook is allowed to change (the list lives in src/traits.js HOOKS). No other fields are accepted — no conditions, no usage limits, no references to other traits. A trooper takes a trait by listing its id in data/roster.json. A trait that cannot be written this way is flavour text, not a trait.
_coolHead: SPEC.md §5 first wrote Cool Head as 'no alert rise, once per mission'. A usage limit is a condition, not a modifier, so it became a flat -1 to the alert gunfire raises.

steady-hands.name: Steady Hands
steady-hands.description: Cuts his fuses short. His charges go off a turn sooner — good near dawn, bad if he is still inside the blast.

quick-work.name: Quick Work
quick-work.description: Has a charge set before anyone else has the wrapper off. Placing a charge costs him nothing.

cats-eyes.name: Cat's Eyes
cats-eyes.description: Sees in the dark better than the rest. One more hex of spot radius.

treetops.name: Treetops
treetops.description: Knows how to come down through branches. A bad landing costs him nothing.

cool-head.name: Cool Head
cool-head.description: Fires short, controlled bursts. His gunfire raises the alert one step less.

ox.name: Ox
ox.description: Carries more than he should. One extra charge.
